spec: Implement module adder8(input wire [7:0] a, input wire [7:0] b, output wire [8:0] sum). Purely combinational unsigned addition. sum must contain the full 9-bit result a+b, including carry. No clock or state.

Implement module encoder4(input wire [3:0] req, output reg valid, output reg [1:0] index). Purely combinational priority encoder. valid is 1 iff any req bit is 1. index is the highest asserted bit number (bit 3 has highest priority). For req=0, valid=0 and index=0. Assign outputs for every input.

Implement module counter4(input wire clk, input wire rst, input wire en, output reg [3:0] q). On each rising clk edge: if active-high synchronous rst is 1, set q=0; else if en=1 increment modulo 16; else hold. Reset has priority over enable. No asynchronous reset. State before the first reset edge is unspecified.
Implement module mux8(input wire [7:0] a, b, input wire sel, output wire [7:0] y). Combinational: y=a when sel=0, otherwise y=b.

Implement module alu8(input wire [7:0] a, b, input wire [2:0] op, output reg [7:0] y). Combinational unsigned 8-bit ALU. op 0:add modulo 256; 1:a-b modulo 256; 2:AND; 3:OR; 4:XOR; 5:a<<1 modulo 256; 6:a>>1 logical; 7:unsigned a<b (8-bit 0 or 1).

Implement module shift8(input wire [7:0] a, input wire [2:0] amount, input wire right, output wire [7:0] y). Combinational logical shift. right=1: a>>amount; right=0: a<<amount. Zero fill; truncate to 8 bits.
Implement module signedcmp8(input wire signed [7:0] a, b, output wire lt, eq, gt). Combinational two's-complement signed comparison: lt=(a<b), eq=(a==b), gt=(a>b).
Implement module popcount8(input wire [7:0] a, output reg [3:0] count). Combinational population count: number of 1 bits in a, from 0 through 8.
Implement module decoder3(input wire [2:0] index, input wire en, output wire [7:0] y). Combinational 3-to-8 one-hot decoder: en=0 gives 0; otherwise bit index is 1 and other bits are 0.
Implement module gray8(input wire [7:0] binary, output wire [7:0] gray). Combinational binary to reflected Gray code conversion: gray=binary XOR (binary>>1).
Implement module parity8(input wire [7:0] a, output wire parity). Combinational parity equals 1 exactly when a contains an odd number of 1 bits.
Implement module saturating8(input wire [7:0] a, b, output wire [7:0] y). Combinational unsigned saturating sum: min(a+b,255), retaining the carry for saturation.
Implement module leadingzero8(input wire [7:0] a, output reg [3:0] count). Combinational count of consecutive zeros from bit 7 toward bit 0, before the first 1; count=8 when a=0.

Implement module dff8(input wire clk, rst, en, input wire [7:0] d, output reg [7:0] q). All state changes only on rising clk. rst is active-high synchronous and has priority. State before the first reset edge is unspecified. On rst set q=0; else if en set q=d; else hold.

Implement module shiftreg8(input wire clk, rst, en, serial_in, output reg [7:0] q). All state changes only on rising clk. rst is active-high synchronous and has priority. State before the first reset edge is unspecified. On rst q=0; else if en q={q[6:0],serial_in}; else hold.

Implement module updown8(input wire clk, rst, en, up, output reg [7:0] q). All state changes only on rising clk. rst is active-high synchronous and has priority. State before the first reset edge is unspecified. On rst q=0; else if en, add 1 when up=1 or subtract 1 when up=0, modulo 256; else hold.

Implement module edge_detector(input wire clk, rst, din, output reg pulse). All state changes only on rising clk. rst is active-high synchronous and has priority. State before the first reset edge is unspecified. Register din history and output pulse. On rst both history and pulse=0. Otherwise pulse is 1 for this cycle iff current sampled din=1 and previous sampled din=0. Update history each rising edge.

Implement module pulse_div4(input wire clk, rst, en, output reg pulse). All state changes only on rising clk. rst is active-high synchronous and has priority. State before the first reset edge is unspecified. Internal counter initially 0 on reset. Each enabled edge increments modulo 4. pulse=1 on an enabled edge whose old counter was 3, otherwise pulse=0 (including disabled edges). Disabled edges hold counter, not pulse.

Implement module sequence101(input wire clk, rst, din, output reg match). All state changes only on rising clk. rst is active-high synchronous and has priority. State before the first reset edge is unspecified. Registered serial 101 detector. Reset clears history and match. After each nonreset rising edge, match=1 iff the last three nonreset sampled bits are 1,0,1. Overlapping matches allowed (10101 gives two pulses). Fewer than three bits since reset cannot match.

Implement module fifo4x8(input wire clk, rst, wr_en, rd_en, input wire [7:0] wdata, output wire full, empty, output reg [2:0] count, output wire [7:0] rdata). All state changes only on rising clk. rst is active-high synchronous and has priority. State before the first reset edge is unspecified. FIFO depth 4, width 8. On reset empty=1, full=0, count=0. rdata is combinational oldest stored byte, or 0 when empty. At an edge accept write iff wr_en and pre-edge count<4; accept read iff rd_en and pre-edge count>0. Decisions use PRE-edge state independently: full+both requests only reads; empty+both requests only writes (no bypass). Accepted read removes oldest; accepted write appends wdata. Maintain count and order across pointer wrap.
